name: Hlk Fm22X → Enroll
description: Starts the face enrollment process with a name and direction. To successfully enroll a face, you need to successfully and consecutively scan the face from all directions. A failure in one direction will require enrolling the face again from the start.

config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name associated with the face. Up to 32 ASCII characters.

config_entries.label: Direction
config_entries.description: The direction to scan the face for. `1` for center, `2` for right, `4` for left, `8` for down, and `16` for up.
